name: Shawnee Springs
tagline: Link to Shawnee Springs Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/ShawneeSpringsWinery
description: Shawnee Springs is a working pumpkin patch in 093 County Road 6, OH. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
